samples.name: icon-task-hunt-birds
samples.prompt: ONE tiny task icon for cozy medieval Slavic village game. Match supplied Kenney Tiny Town/Tiny Farm minimal chunky pixel-art style. Strict 16x16 logical pixel grid enlarged nearest-neighbor, each logical pixel solid square. Flat earthy colors, maximum two shades per material. Transparent background, centered with one logical pixel margin. Clear simple silhouette at native size. No gradients, texture, antialiasing, glow, shadow, text, border or scenery. Leather sling holding a grey stone, beside a small falling brown feather. Thick enough leather cords to read as pixels, simple feather with one shaft.
